outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission rates
cohort: The study included 506,297 singleton births (>= 28 weeks) in Victoria, Australia, comparing outcomes before (January 2014-June 2019) and after (July 2019-December 2020) the implementation of the Safer Baby Bundle.
finding: SBB implementation in Victoria, Australia, was associated with a significant reduction in perinatal mortality and a trend towards reduced stillbirth rates, without an increase in early term iatrogenic births or other adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: No significant changes were observed in caesarean section or induction of labour trends in SBB sites.
